rationale: Temporal TypeScript SDK is a production-grade durable execution platform (525 TS source files, 184 directories) that directly addresses the 'queue / job scheduling' pipeline concern. It provides: (1) Workflow orchestration with deterministic replay for fault tolerance, (2) ScheduleClient for cron-like scheduling with overlap policies, backfill, and timezone support, (3) Activity heartbeating and cancellation for long-running scraping tasks, (4) Interceptor pattern for cross-cutting concerns (logging, metrics, tracing via OpenTelemetry), (5) External storage (S3/GCS) for large payload handling, (6) Nexus for service-to-service operations, (7) Multiple isolation mechanisms (VM, threaded VM) for sandboxed workflow execution, (8) Comprehensive test suite (277 integration tests, stress/nightly CI). Architecture documented in data-converter.md and protobuf-libraries.md. MIT licensed. Used at scale by major companies. Directly relevant as the durable queue/orchestration backbone for a scraping pipeline.
limitations: Not a scraper itself - provides orchestration layer only
Worker requires Node.js (native modules, worker_threads, vm, AsyncLocalStorage, async_hooks) - not compatible with Bun/Deno/Cloudflare Workers for worker-level features
Requires Temporal Server (self-hosted or Temporal Cloud) as backend
Protobuf-based wire protocol adds complexity for custom payloads
